title: Crispy Chicken Thighs With Hot Honey Mustard Recipe
ldName: Crispy chicken thighs with hot honey mustard
ldKeywords: Steam, Combi oven, Chicken thigh, Hot honey, mustard, easy
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 banana shallots, finely sliced into half-moons
4 sprigs of dill, plus extra fronds picked, to serve
8 bone-in chicken thighs, patted dry with kitchen paper
ldInstructionsRaw: Preheat the oven to 200°C – if your oven has the option to steam, fill up the reservoir with water
Turn on to a low steam setting (25% humidity). Line a roasting tray with baking paper

To make the quick-pickled shallots, place the shallots, lemon peel and dill in a bowl. Combine the apple cider vinegar, water, honey, salt, peppercorns and mustard seeds in a saucepan. Warm gently for 2 minutes, stirring until the sugar and salt has dissolved, then pour over the sliced shallots. Leave to lightly pickle
For the chicken, combine all the spices, salt and olive oil in a large bowl. Coat the chicken with this mixture and transfer to the baking tray. Roast the chicken for 30 minutes
Meanwhile, to make the lemon yoghurt, combine all the ingredients in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Chill until ready to serve
For the hot honey mustard glaze, gently warm all the ingredients in a small saucepan with a good pinch of salt. Keep warm
Once the chicken is crisp and cooked through, brush generously with the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes
Spread the lemon yoghurt onto a serving platter and arrange the glazed chicken over the top. Scatter generously with dill fronds, flaky salt and the quick-pickled shallots
